[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Fitstar: Personalized workout planning, generates customized schedule based on goals and availability. (Web, iOS, Android)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Coach.me: Connects with certified coaches for customized training plans, tracks progress. (Web, iOS, Android)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for creating a schedule:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start with your availability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Prioritize your goals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Be flexible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Batch similar workouts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Leave rest days.
